templates.description_template: The user learns that the child's current kindergarten may face closure or instability and needs to consider alternative plans.

memory_detail_anchors.text: 幼儿园不稳定的消息仍然模糊，用户还没有拿到正式通知或具体原因。
memory_detail_anchors.expected_response_mode: 后续应先帮用户确认信息来源、正式通知和可行动窗口。

memory_detail_anchors.text: 用户真正担心的是孩子被现实变动反复折腾，而不只是换不换幼儿园。
memory_detail_anchors.expected_response_mode: 回应应接住孩子稳定感，而不是只给换园清单。

templates.description_template: The user discusses a collaboration where concepts and implementation levels are not aligned.

memory_detail_anchors.text: 合作消耗点是概念层和实现层反复错位，不是单次沟通不顺。
memory_detail_anchors.expected_response_mode: 后续应围绕对齐成本、是否继续投入和边界设置回应。

memory_detail_anchors.text: 用户真正累的是每次都要重新对齐底层逻辑，担心它吞掉有限精力。
memory_detail_anchors.expected_response_mode: 回应应识别持续消耗，而不是只建议再沟通一次。

templates.description_template: The user tries to discuss family coordination with the partner but feels that practical support and emotional recognition are both insufficient.

memory_detail_anchors.text: 家里分工问题表面是事务分配，底下是支持感和被看见的问题。
memory_detail_anchors.expected_response_mode: 回应应同时处理具体分工和情绪识别。

memory_detail_anchors.text: 用户担心自己说具体事务时，对方只听到任务，没有听到真实情绪。
memory_detail_anchors.expected_response_mode: 回应应帮用户把事务诉求和情绪诉求分开表达。

templates.description_template: The user notices that late-night work and child-related interruptions have made sleep fragmented, affecting patience and focus the next day.

memory_detail_anchors.text: 睡眠被打碎会放大用户在育儿和工作上的反应，影响耐心和专注。
memory_detail_anchors.expected_response_mode: 回应应把疲惫作为判断变量，而不是把所有情绪都归因于事件本身。

memory_detail_anchors.text: 用户不确定自己是在处理事件，还是在被疲惫推着走。
memory_detail_anchors.expected_response_mode: 回应应帮助用户区分事实压力和疲惫放大。

templates.title_template: A friend asks for a quick catch-up
templates.description_template: A friend invites the user to catch up, but the user is unsure whether to spend limited free time socializing or recovering alone.

memory_detail_anchors.text: 用户想维持朋友关系，但最近社交电量偏低，更需要恢复空间。
memory_detail_anchors.expected_response_mode: 回应应允许轻量维护关系，而不是默认建议立刻赴约。

memory_detail_anchors.text: 用户会把是否想见朋友当成观察自身状态的信号。
memory_detail_anchors.expected_response_mode: 回应应把邀约当成状态观察点，而不是单纯社交选择。

templates.title_template: A paper deadline needs practical triage
templates.description_template: The user needs to decide which parts of a paper draft deserve careful revision and which parts can be simplified before the deadline.

memory_detail_anchors.text: 论文截稿前用户需要区分必须认真改的部分和可以先放过的部分。
memory_detail_anchors.expected_response_mode: 回应应帮助用户做优先级取舍，而不是追求全部完美。

memory_detail_anchors.text: 用户很难接受稿件不够完美，但现实时间不允许逐段打磨。
memory_detail_anchors.expected_response_mode: 回应应接住完美主义和交付压力的冲突。

templates.title_template: Child has a difficult drop-off morning
templates.description_template: The child cries during kindergarten drop-off, making the user worry about adaptation and whether recent family changes are affecting the child.

memory_detail_anchors.text: 孩子早上入园哭闹后，用户会反复回想门口那个画面。
memory_detail_anchors.expected_response_mode: 回应应先承认具体触发画面，再讨论观察和下一步。

memory_detail_anchors.text: 用户分不清孩子是真的适应慢，还是自己太容易被孩子情绪带走。
memory_detail_anchors.expected_response_mode: 回应应帮用户区分孩子状态、家长反应和需要向老师确认的信息。
